ticker_notes.ANT: 預期垃圾評級及雙 B 而非投資級

2116208327864762417.en_summary: $INTC is on pace for its worst day in over 50 years even though estimates still have profits growing more than 10x to nearly $20B by 2028. Data center operating margins have reached 42% and cost of making newest chips has fallen ~40% since Q1.
2116208327864762417.zh_summary: $INTC 正邁向超過 50 年來最差的一天，儘管估計利潤仍將增長超過 10 倍，至 2028 年接近 200 億美元。數據中心營業利潤率已達 42%，最新晶片製造成本自第一季以來下降約 40%。

ticker_notes.INTC: 利潤預期大幅增長，數據中心利潤率 42%，成本下降 40%
